request.query: For a finite multivariate polynomial expansion over a NormedCommRing with NormOneClass, strict coefficient norm bound and vanishing of terms below a real coordinate cost threshold, bound the norm of evaluation by cardinality times coefficient bound times real power decay

items.name: Polynomial.le_gaussNorm
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p

items.name: Polynomial.mahlerMeasure_le_sum_norm_coeff
items.type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ), p.mahlerMeasure ≤ p.sum fun x a => ‖a‖

items.name: FormalMultilinearSeries.norm_mul_pow_le_mul_pow_of_lt_radius
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
  (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) {r : NNReal},
  ↑r < p.radius → ∃ a ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, ∃ C > 0, ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖p n‖ * ↑r ^ n ≤ C * a ^ n

items.name: FormalMultilinearSeries.norm_le_div_pow_of_pos_of_lt_radius
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {F : Type u_3} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [inst_3 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
  (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) {r : NNReal}, 0 < r → ↑r < p.radius → ∃ C > 0, ∀ (n : ℕ), ‖p n‖ ≤ C / ↑r ^ n

items.name: summable_norm_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one'
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedRing F] [NormOneClass F] [NormMulClass F] {k : ℕ} {r : F},
  ‖r‖ < 1 → ∀ {u : ℕ → F}, (u =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => ↑(n ^ k)) → Summable fun n => ‖u n * r ^ n‖
